assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has a diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation coded as I48.0.
The patient has a diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation coded as I48.91.
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease coded as I25.10.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was performed with CPT code 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The diagnostic procedure is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and guide ongoing management.
